Fast, inexpensive coastal reconnaissance. Light weapons; vulnerable to warships.
Reduced damage against: heavy infantry, armored vehicles & constructs, warships, large armored creatures, buildings & walls.
Threats: Warships and air attacks.
Cannot attack flying targets.

units.name: Skyfire Escort
units.help:
Protects transports and warships from aircraft. Modest damage against buildings.
Effective against: aircraft & flying creatures.
Reduced damage against: heavy infantry, armored vehicles & constructs, warships, large armored creatures, buildings & walls.
Weapon bonus: +35% damage against aircraft and flying creatures.
Threats: Warships and coastal artillery.

units.name: Furnace Barge
units.help:
Long-range coastal bombardment against buildings and grouped ground troops. Vulnerable to aircraft and faster warships.
Effective against: infantry, buildings & walls.
Weapon bonus: +40% damage against buildings and walls.
Threats: Warships and air attacks.
Minimum firing distance: 2.5 tiles. Protect it from enemies inside that distance.
Cannot attack flying targets.

units.name: Hoardwing Carrier Bomber
units.help:
Ground-attack bomber with two salvos. Automatically returns to an eligible aviation facility to refuel and rearm.
Effective against: warships, artillery, battering rams.
Weapon bonus: +40% damage against buildings and walls.
Threats: Anti-air units and interceptors.
Cannot attack flying targets.

units.name: Hoardwing Carrier
units.help: Flying transport carrying ten actual land units. Right-click to board and U to unload over clear ground. Flies and must return to refuel.

units.name: Kobold Trader
units.help: Travels between two friendly markets to earn Trade Credits. Right-click a destination market; a second market at least eight tiles away is required.
